subject.title: fix(amazon-bedrock-mantle): dedupe the IAM token-failure diagnostic per region (#67288)

question: Should the Mantle owner accept suppressing later failure-detail changes for a continuously failing region until token success or gateway restart?
rationale: The patch intentionally trades diagnostic freshness for bounded log volume; source tests can verify the mechanism but cannot choose the desired operator-observability policy.

options.title: Accept bounded diagnostic cadence
options.body: Accept one failure diagnostic per region per process after reviewing redacted real-host proof that IAM attempts continue on repeated discovery calls.

options.title: Keep per-failure diagnostics
options.body: Reject process-lifetime suppression and request a narrower rate-limit or aggregation design that preserves changed error details.

recommendation.title: Accept bounded diagnostic cadence
recommendation.body: Accept one failure diagnostic per region per process after reviewing redacted real-host proof that IAM attempts continue on repeated discovery calls.

likelyOwner.reason: This is the only evidence-backed recent contributor associated with the exact Mantle discovery design in the available history; confidence is limited because current-main ownership could not be independently traced.
